issue.title: Capture drawers and % directives
issue.description: Bob's capture language reads as three rules: @ says where, # names a place or a type, and % says how. `Text @note+id#drawer [#type]` files a note in a task drawer, creating the drawer when it is missing and optionally retyping the task in the same transaction. `%c`, `%n`, `%t`, and `%l` replace trailing `#`, `%`, `@@template:`, and `URL %`. Typing `#`, `%`, or `@note+id#` in Bob Mac Capture opens a bob-described menu with nothing preselected. Every retired form is deleted outright, with no aliases.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/capture_drawers_and_directives.md requests this work
